text: Binary row measure from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP): 1 if at least one comment uses a concrete personal anecdote, meaning the commenter recounts a specific experience of their own (or a first-hand event involving themselves) as part of their argument. Returns 0 if the list is valid and nonempty but no comment does; generic reasoning, hypotheticals, others' stories, external quotations and statistics don't count. Empty list gives 0; missing or malformed input gives null. Ignore text reporting the OP's view change, delta awards, thank-you or resolution updates, or whether the outcome occurred (generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not outcome reporting); list order is irrelevant.
